title: Imiqathango neMimiselo
description: Imithetho ye-I Need Save: ukusetyenziswa kobuqu, uxanduva ngelungelo lokushicilela, ukusetyenziswa okungavumelekanga, imida yenkonzo nokuxela ukwaphulwa.
body:
Ngokusebenzisa i-I Need Save (ineedsave.com), uyavumelana nale miqathango nemimiselo ilandelayo. Ukuba awuvumi, nceda ungayisebenzisi inkonzo.

Malunga nenkonzo

I Need Save sisixhobo sasimahla esikuncedayo ukuba ukhuphele iividiyo, iifoto nesandi kumxholo kawonke-wonke kumaqonga onxibelelwano nakwezinye iiwebhusayithi. Asiwugcini kwaye asiwubambi lo mxholo; iifayile zivela kumaqonga azo okuqala. I Need Save ayinxulumananga ne-TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X, Pinterest, okanye nalo naliphi na elinye iqonga, ayixhaswanga ngawo, kwaye ayilohlakani lawo. Zonke iimpawu zorhwebo zezabanini bazo.

Ukusetyenziswa okuvumelekileyo

  • Inkonzo yenzelwe ukusetyenziswa kobuqu, okungekho kwarhwebo.
  • Khuphela kuphela umxholo ongumnini wawo, onemvume yokuwukhuphela, okanye ovunyelwe ukuwukhuphela phantsi komthetho osebenza kuwe.
  • Kwakhona landela imiqathango yeqonga apho umxholo uvela khona.

Ilungelo lokushicilela noxanduva lwakho

Umxholo okhutshelweyo uhlala uyipropathi yomdali wawo. Unoxanduva olupheleleyo ngendlela osebenzisa ngayo iifayile ozikhuphelayo. Musa ukuphinda ulayishe, ukuthengisa, okanye ukusebenzisa umxholo wabanye abantu ngeenjongo zorhwebo ngaphandle kwemvume, kwaye soloko ukhankanye umdali.

Ukusetyenziswa okungavumelekanga

  • Ukukhuphela okanye ukusasaza umxholo owaphula umthetho, ilungelo lokushicilela, okanye ubumfihlo babanye abantu.
  • Ukuzama ukufikelela kumxholo wabucala okanye othintelweyo ngaphandle kwelungelo lokwenza oko.
  • Ukusebenzisa iibhothi, izikripthi, okanye inkqubo ezenzekelayo ukufikelela kwinkonzo ngobuninzi obukhulu.
  • Ukuphazamisa, ukulayisha ngokugqithisileyo, okanye ukuzama ukwaphula ukhuseleko lweeseva zethu nenkonzo yethu.

Iingxelo zokwaphulwa kwelungelo lokushicilela

Ukuba ungumnini welungelo lokushicilela kwaye ukholelwa ukuba le nkonzo isetyenziselwa ukulaphula, qhagamshelana nathi ngelinki yomxholo, ubungqina bobunini, nenkcazo emfutshane. Siza kuyihlola ingxelo kwaye sinokuthintela ukufikelela kwilinki ekuthethwa ngayo.

Ukufumaneka

Inkonzo inikezelwa simahla kwaye inokutshintsha, inikwe umda, okanye iyekiswe nangaliphi na ixesha ngaphandle kwesaziso. Amaqonga okuqala nawo anokuthintela okanye avimbe ukufikelela, ngoko asingawo wonke umxholo onokukhutshelwa ngalo lonke ixesha.

Ukungabi naxanduva

Inkonzo inikezelwa “njengoko injalo” kwaye “njengoko ifumaneka”, ngaphandle kweziqinisekiso zalo naluphi na uhlobo, kuquka nasiphi na isiqinisekiso sokuba iya kusoloko isebenza, ingabi nazimpazamo, okanye ifanelekile kwinjongo ethile.

Umda woxanduva

Ukuya kuthi ga kwinqanaba elivunyelwe ngumthetho, asinaxanduva ngayo nayiphi na ilahleko ngqo okanye engathanga ngqo evela ekusebenziseni kwakho inkonzo okanye kumxholo owukhuphelayo.

Iilinki zamaqela esithathu

Le webhusayithi iqulethe iilinki eziya kwiisayithi nakwiinkonzo zamaqela esithathu. Asinaxanduva ngomxholo wazo okanye ngemigaqo-nkqubo yazo.

Utshintsho kule miqathango

Le miqathango inokuhlaziywa ngamaxesha athile. Ngokuqhubeka usebenzisa inkonzo emva kokuba utshintsho lupapashiwe, wamkela uguqulelo lwamva nje.

Umthetho olawulayo

Le miqathango ilawulwa yimithetho yeRiphabhliki yase-Indonesia.

Qhagamshelana nathi

Imibuzo neengxelo zingathunyelwa ngeelinki zoqhagamshelwano ezisezantsi kwiphepha ngalinye okanye nge-abidhanan.my.id. Nceda ufunde kwakhona uMgaqo-nkqubo wabucala wethu.
